item.title: Using Linux Capabilities with pam_cap.so
item.description: In this blog post, we will continue exploring Linux Capabilities by learning how to use pam_cap.so, a PAM module provided by libcap. This module allows Capabilities to be made available to Users’ sessions as they go through PAM authentication process. And these Capabilities gets assigned to any Process launched in the resulting sessions.
